package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ModuleHandler handles module endpoints.
type ModuleHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	GetUC     moduleuc.GetModule
	ListUC    moduleuc.ListModules
	Access    contentaccess.Service
}

func (h ModuleHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	filters, err := parsers.ParseModuleFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	fields := queryfields.Parse(r.URL.Query().Get("fields"), queryfields.ModuleAllowedFields)
	_, role, ok := middleware.UserFromContext(r.Context())
	privileged := ok && isPositionPrivilegedRole(role)
	if !privileged && filters.CourseID != "" {
		if err := h.Access.RequireCourse(r.Context(), filters.CourseID); err != nil {
			writeContentAccessError(w, err)
			return
		}
	}
	if filters.Scope == "all" && !privileged {
		writeModuleError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if (filters.Scope == "content" || filters.Scope == "course_only" || filters.Scope == "internal") && !privileged {
		writeModuleError(w, domain.ErrValidation)
		return
	}
	if filters.CourseID == "" && filters.Scope == "" && !privileged {
		filters.Scope = "independent"
	}
	filters.ActiveOnly = !privileged
	items, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), moduleuc.ListModulesInput{
		CourseID:   filters.CourseID,
		Scope:      filters.Scope,
		TechID:     filters.TechID,
		ActiveOnly: filters.ActiveOnly,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	response, err := h.mapModuleListResponse(r, items, fields)
	if err != nil {
		writeModuleError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"modules": response})
}

func writeModuleError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if err == domain.ErrConflict {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
}
